areas.t: An active weather pattern is expected this week. Intermittent periods of gusty winds will keep dispersion and air quality good. A frontal boundary will pass through the state on Monday. Gusty southwest winds will become northwesterly late in the afternoon. High pressure will be over the region Tuesd
